In Samsung settings, open Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps and add NethCTI. Under App info choose Battery → Unrestricted. Names may vary by device version.

While reception is enabled, a persistent notification remains visible and battery use may increase. During ringing, the app temporarily enables sound and raises ring volume to at least 50%, which may also make other alerts audible. Previous settings are restored afterwards, preserving your manual changes. Configure Do Not Disturb exceptions too. Reception is unavailable without network access or after a force stop.
